batting.name: A Badoni
batting.dismissal: c JC Buttler b N Burger

batting.dismissal: c Dhruv Jurel b R Ashwin

balls.text: Would've been wide had he left it but he plinked the yorker well down leg, to deep fine leg.
Slappage. Samson crouches a bit, waits for the back-of-lengther outside off while staying deep in the crease, and muscles it over wide long-off for a 79-metre six.
Fullish and wide, Jurel is happy to steer it more with grace than power, to deep point. Kinda odd he didn't go harder
Into the pitch, just down leg, Jurel helps it fine with a pull
Slow into the pitch, very short but rises only to waist-height. 122ks. Samson shaped to pull it but had to crouch due to the low bounce. Couldn't adjust in time, toed it wide to the bowler's right
Arguably in the slot outside off, Samson swings big and misses
Padikkal charges in from long-off, slides and gets hands on it but can't hold on! Into the pitch outside off, Jurel tried to flat-bat it up and over, got a top edge.
Jurel tries the splits-sweep and misses. The front foot slid right across towards cover and the full ball beat the bat and hit the body
Full and wide, sliced to deep third
Very full and along the offside tramline, drilled straight to cover
Very short and just inside the tramline, rises around shoulder-height. Slapped over the cover infield, stopped in the deep
Test-like leave from Jurel, very smart. He knew Naveen would go wide again, this was very full too and well outside the tramline

Wide review is taken, this time by LSG. This is tighter but a very T20 event. Ball was into the pitch and close to the return crease, Jurel went across -  was around seventh stump - and tried to slap it behind square. Got beaten. Third umpire says the on-field decision will remain
Wide yorker beats bat, looked to have gone under it. Jurel thinks about asking for a review, Samson says no
Free hit is an attempted yorker that ends up in Samson's slot. His back leg was deep in the crease and behind the line at the point of impact, front leg was out the way and he drove through the line
Yorker down leg, 141ks, beats the flick and goes to the keeper. Wasn't that far from the boot, so KL and Co decide to review only for the dreaded siren to go off. Thakur has overstepped
Yorker on fourth from around the wicket. Samson was well behind the crease but could only work it through midwicket. Lack of timing worked for him as he took two
Jurel runs across along the crease to get inside the line but gets no pace to work with. Ball was into the pitch and he had to adjust and could only bunt it leg side
Fullish at the stumps, worked to long-on
Into the pitch, 133ks, at the body, helped to deep fine leg with a pull
Punches it down the ground

Tipped over the boundary, brilliant effort though from Naveen at long-on. He ran to the left, threw himself in the air and tried to hold on to with full reach and one hand while in motion, but it was too much. Was a fullish wide ball outside off to which Jurel got on one knee and flapped it. Had the optics of a sweep but went straight as it was fetched from wide
Length on leg, 96ks, clipped to midwicket
Length wide outside off, spins back in and is cut to short third

Appeal, given. Hetmyer reviews. Think it was caught behind even though Rahul dislodged the stumps while lifting his hand in celebration. Length ball landed in line and turned away, the lid-less Hetmyer's front foot was well in front of the crease and he tried to defend with a straight bat. Hawk-Eye shows there was a feather, much to Hetmyer's surprise. Rahul and Bishnoi are delighted, LSG are pulling it back
Fullish outside off, guided to short third
Length on leg, punched to long-on
Back of length on leg, 97ks, looked slower and bounce was on the lower side, punched to long-on
Full around fourth, driven to long-on off the inner-half of the bat
Wide and full, Hetmyer uses his reach to slap it through cover
Full on the pads, 99ks, beats the flick and hits the outer-half of the front pad
Length on leg, clipped to the legside
Swats it to adjust with the low bounce. Was slow and shortish around off, Hetmyer got low and initially shaped for a back-foot shot
Length on leg, 132ks, clipped to square leg. Might've been inside edge onto pad

Tries doing something similar but holes out to deep-backward square. Was a shortish ball, 119ks, just outside off, Parag tried dragging it across with a pull, top edged it and Hooda took a dolly. Excellent 93-run stand though
Wind-up flat-bat! Sails over long-off. Cross-court slappage, Matt Hayden calls it, was a slower bouncer outside off, it sat up and Parag swung his bat the whole arc.
Wide and full, Samson reaches out - upper body only - and slaps it to long-off. Clothed though
Naveen's wide-yorker plan isn't working cos the batters aren't moving across. Even if they are chasing, they've been doing it from close to where they're standing. This was too wide anyway, let go
Wide and very full, slashed. Not the best connection, goes to deep point
Cut behind point. Parag picks up the length and lunges to carve it with power
Wide yorker. Samson shaped to chase but kept his feet in and leave it
Thakur can't close out the over, Samson goes across and lifts the back of lengther, from outside off, over short fine leg, with a ramp-pull.

Pitched up, driven back to the bowler, who in follow-through, helps it back onto the stumps. Run-out referral sent upstairs. Think it wasn't fully intentional, he was wide of the stumps and the ball angled back. It took a bit of time and Parag was able to dive back in time. Stumps didn't light up
Back of length outside off, chopped to deep point. So far so good from Thakur
Shortish over middle, Parag backs away and tries to upper cut it over third. Misses
Wide yorker, it's outside the tramline. Parag shaped to chase it but backed away last second and let it go
He's going fuller now, so that's the change in plan. It's at the stumps again and is pushed to long-on
Pushes the fullish ball on the pads to long-on
Fullish on leg, 99ks, tucked to long-on
Pushes it to long-off
Length on middle, punched off the back foot, to long-on. Samson brings up his first fifty vs LSG, he raises his bat and the crowd are full enthu, as the kids (I presume) call it

Straight up off the sweep, Mohsin has dropped it! Don't think he ever got under it. He was at short-45, moved to the left, the ball was a couple of feet further forward, he reached out with hope more than anything else and got nothing on it. Was a length ball coming in at leg, Parag went for the bit hit, across the line
Full outside off, pushed to long-off

Googly has been pulled with the spin. Samson made it look easier than it was. Back of length, coming in to leg, he rocked back and swivelled seamlessly, despite the low bounce, and lifted in the empty acreage at midwicket
Length on off, 99ks, punched off the back foot to long-off. Ball got true bounce this time
Fullish on leg, clipped to midwicket
Back-of-length on middle. That'd be close to a shooter on a different pitch, not on this one. Samson stays low and clips it to midwicket
Length on leg, clipped to deep midwicket
Full just outside off, punched to long-off's left
Fullish on leg, defended towards midwicket
Shortish on leg, lowish bounce, clipped to deep-backward square
Think Bishnoi's just trying to get out of the over now. Much shorter this time. Slowish around sixth, guided to deep point
Samson goes over long-on this time. Avid reader of length again. This was a legbreak around fourth, step-hit for the skipper. Biggie too, brings up RR's 100
Length on leg, clipped to midwicket
Parag hits it on length. RR's players have shown proper clarity when going big. This was a googly on off, full too, Parag lunged a bit and effectively slog-swept it over long-on
Length on fourth, punched back to the bowler
Flat on the fuller side of length, good change in length by Krunal, 101ks. Samson tried tucking it with a fully closed bat face, luckily got an inside edge onto pad
Full on fifth, pushed to long-off
Length on middle, flatty at 103ks, punched to mid-on, off the back foot
Pushes the full ball outside off, to long-off
Flighted at the stumps, nudged leg side
Fullish on leg, beats the flick and goes off the pad to short third

RR have marked their man and taking him down. Another bumper, not sure where it eventually came up to but Samson had no problem pulling again, cleared the forward-square boundary with ease. Replay comes in late, ball landed real short but rose only to waist-height despite Samson being deep in the crease

Samson now takes on Thakur. 132ks bouncer but there's no bite off the surface, it's head-height but still felt like it sat up, Samson went back and swivel-pulled it across the face, hit it over square leg
Length around off, backs away and punches to cover
Much shorter this time, induces the top edge from the pull, lands safely and goes to long-on. Bowled from real close to the crease
Parag sees it short again and deposits it over cow corner. It sat up again, was just outside off, and was pulled for a flat six
Long-ish run-up for a slow cutter. Into the pitch on fourth, clipped to midwicket for a quick two
Shortish dart on the pads, helped to short fine leg
Shortish on middle, keeps low and skids but Samson's whip is quick and directs the ball to deep midwicket
Shortish ball doesn't get much bounce, chipped off the back foot with a closed face. Lands around wide mid-on and goes to the deep fielder
Full on the outer-half of the pads, 89ks, nudged to square leg
Length on leg, clipped to square leg
Full on leg, Samson had made room but Krunal held his line, went flat, and ensured that it could only be driven back to him
Length outside off, punched to long-off

Wide called, Bishnoi wants it reviewed. KL is convinced. Was a shortish ball just down leg. Samson was in the crease, with feet jammed, the front leg was hovering up as he tried glancing it fine. Ultra-Edge shows a spike with ball next to trouser. So, the decision is reversed.
Wide on a length, cut to deep point
Full on leg, clipped towards long-on
Length on leg, clipped to midwicket. Another legbreak, more loop this time
Shortish middle-stump ball is flat, three-fourth of the way up the stumps, clipped to deep midwicket
Tucked off the back foot to deep midwicket
Full on middle and leg, pushed to long-off
Flat on a back of length around off, punched to long-off
Length on the pads, clipped to the leg side

Samson holds his ground and is in Krunal's way, it was a caught-and bowled chance as the leading edge took the ball ballooning to Samson's right. It was high-ish, Krunal likely would've gotten to it if there were no obstructions. Samson wasn't at fault too, though. Krunal gave him a bear hug after colliding, so all was good.
Length on leg, clipped to deep midwicket

Clothed to mid-on and Jaiswal's distraught. Mohsin has shelled a few dollars but goes pace-on, into the pitch to hurry the in-form youngster. He went though with the shot but could only pop it straight to the man. The pitch has been on the slower side so far but this ball steered away from that trend.

Jaiswal channels his inner Warner and paddles it off balance over fine leg for six!r Length on fifth, Jaiswal slid his back foot wide, has that straight while the front foot buckled and he helped it over
Clips the full ball to midwicket for a quick run

Helped along, there is deep-backward square but this flat hit is too wide. 61-metre hit, so Samson was eyeing the shorter boundary there. Was an into-the-pitch 126ks ball at the body, Samson was really deep in the crease again. He's taking an open stance, with left leg out the way,
Slower one into the pitch, angles away through fourth stump, Samson tries defending towards mid-off and is beaten
Caressed off the back foot, from deep in the crease, gets it wide to the right of backward point. Back of lengther, played from the top of bounce

Proactive from Jaiswal, the room he made was pre-meditated and Naveen might've seen him. The full ball was on the inner-half of leg stump, but Jaiswal's reach and power were good enough to bullet the ball to the cover boundary.
Length on leg, clipped to the leg-side pocket off the back foot
Full and slow on fourth, patted off the front foot to cover.
Length around middle and leg, clipped to midwicket
Quick single to mid-off. Full ball angling away towards fourth, Jaiswal's unfazed by Naveen's angles
Length at the stumps, clipped through midwicket.
Beaten on the cut. Similar to the second ball of the over, this time Samson went harder at it.
Worked across to the leg side
Cutter has been cut, too fine for deep-backward point to be in play. Back of length, around fourth stump, Jaiswal stood leg side of the ball and didn't need all that room to get control
Thumped through the line. Too full from Mohsin and Jasiwal drives it hard and straight of mid-off
Wide on a back of length, 132ks, late dab to deep third
Back of length on off, tucked towards mid-off. Back-foot play, quick run taken

Nicked off on the flashing cover drive. Naveen is pumped! Excellent low catch from Rahul too. Was very full, there for the drive, but it's never as straightforward with Naveen's angles. Delivered from wide of the crease, it came in towards fifth stump, was coming back in. Buttler buckled his back knee and tried muscling it. The sound of the nick was like a stick breaking, it hovered low to Rahul's right. He was wrong-footed, as the first step was to the leg side, but he then flung himself low and timed the gather well.
This was blatantly slow and Buttler whips it with one hand over midwicket. Don't think that was in control as he picked it up from just outside off, but he got it deep into the outfield
Three-quarter length around fourth, defended with an open face towards point. Seemed slower but I wasn't sure, 110ks shows the graphic later
Fullish on fourth, punched back to the bowler
Slashed over wide third. It was too full and there was no one in the outfield. A bit of width offered helped Buttler use it as a free hit
Pitched right up on fifth, pushed to the right of deep cover. Released from very wide of the crease, which is a staple with Naveen. He has a wanger-arm too, a la Bumrah
Gorgeous ball to beat the outside edge! Fuller side of length, shaped in towards off before straightening. Jaiswal tried defending with an open face but close to the body, which saved him
Length around sixth, driven wristily from the top of the bounce, to deep cover
Length at the stumps, clipped to midwicket
Too wide. Buttler has a go, can't reach it. Back of length, sharp angle. Batter went with upper body only and was beaten on the cut
Tad back of length over middle and off, 131ks, defended off the back foot to the bowler's left. Spongy bounce
Clipped, it's uppish and off off the sticker, lands safely and goes to mid-on. Was a length ball around off, might've gotten more carry than Jaiswal expected.
Beaten first up, not much bounce. Banged into a back of length at 134ks but rises only up to top-of-thigh height. Yasiwal tried the swivel pull
on a length, and wide of off. Slapped to deep point, and RR win by 20 runs
reverse swats this short-of-a-length ball on middle and off to deep third
on a length on sixth stump, as he chops off the bottom edge towards cover
low full toss on leg, with Pooran bending a bit. Swipes to deep midwicket
wow, great bowling! A yorker on fifth stump at 139kph, as Pooran looking to squeeze it out but getting beaten after stepping across a bit
another one which is wide of off, as Pooran misses on what would have been a full toss. Wide not called
goes very wide - around tenth stump - outside off, which Pandya lets go and Samson also misses. They pinch another run, and Pooran is back on strike
sliced to deep backward point! The ball is fullish and angling across to finish a bit wide outside off, as Pooran opens the face of the bat to dispatch it
slower ball, and beaten. Another sharp bouncer on middle, with Pooran looking to pull but getting beaten
now goes for the short ball outside off, which Pooran swat-pulls to long-on on the bounce. But Pooran doesn't run
superb bowling... but it is still four! Low full toss and swung away wide of long-on, as Pooran keeps LSG ticking. Well played too, given he hardly had room there
length ball on leg, as Pandya looked to pull but was hit on his pad. They ran hurriedly for a leg bye, while Sandeep kicking it towards the stumps at the striker's end, but wide of it
dropped by Parag! He was running forward from long-on, and the ball was dipping on to him as he tried to take it low to his left. Pooran launched at this fullish ball on the stumps

Sandeep bowls a bouncer on middle, and goes at a change of pace. Pooran ducks even as the ball zooms up, and is called wide. But Samson reviews. Replays show Pooran crouching, but the third umpire says the ball is still high enough to be called wide
on a length, and wide of off. He goes hoicking, but gets it off the inside half of the bat to deep midwicket
fullish just outside off, and slog swept on the bounce to deep midwicket
looks to sweep but is beaten, with the ball being full outsode off, and turning way

finds Jurel at deep midwicket! Ashwin went with the carrom ball, on a length on middle and leg. Stoinis had his front leg out of the way, and went hammering for a big hit. But Jurel ended up grabbing another catch, as he came a few steps forward

an appeal for lbw, but turned down. Ashwin then signals there might have been bat, even as it seemed to hit him outside off. Pooran went to sweep this fullish ball turning in, with the umpire not signalling leg byes. So there must have been bat
on a length on the stumps, and punched to long-on

deep midwicket ran and dived to his left, but couldn't keep this out. This is another bouncer from Sandeep, as this one arrives on fourth stump. Pulled in the gap by Pooran, beating deep square too. That is also Pooran's fifty
ahh, change of pace, and Pooran is beaten. Another short ball on off, and Pooran went pulling very early
deep point chases to his left to keep it to one, with the ball threatening to pierce the gap between him and deep third. On a length and wide outside off from Sandeep again, as Stoinis went hacking
bowls a bouncer on middle and leg, as Pooran pulls to fine leg
on a length again, and around sixth stump. Slashed to deep point

taken at deep point! The pendulum swings late into the game. Sandeep bowls a wide line to Rahul, with the length being there to be hit. But Rahul went lofting far away from his body. Jurel had to take a few steps forward to catch that, and he did well in the end to send Rahul back
short of a length on leg, and skids through, as Rahul swipes to fine leg
on the bounce to long-off, as Pooran rams it back off a full length wide of off
ahh, went to reverse sweep but missed, with Chahal continuing to go fullish and wide outside off
lofted over extra cover now. The length is full again, and the line quite wide, with Pooran stretching out to loft with a horizontal bat
this travels miles back! Chahal slows it down to go at 77kph, but Pooran is prepared. It is full and a bit wide of off, with Pooran playing away from his body to hammer that back

Rahul skips down and launches... only for Parag to intervene. He was at long-on, as he ran and threw his left hand out to keep the ball out. Superb fielding! Chahal went fullish on the stumps, as Rahul attacked
bowls a wide line again, and goes shorter than the previous ball. Slapped to deep point
ohh, there was a sound when the ball passed the bat, but nobody is excited! Sandeep went on a length, and bowled on seventh stump, as Rahul reached out to try and flash
well bowled! Goes at a near yorker length on middle and off, as Pooran jams it back towards long-on
on a length, and a bit wide of off. Swatted to extra cover, from where Avesh throws wide of the stumps at the non-striker's end. Would have been out had Avesh hit
bowls a bouncer just outside leg, as Pooran skips and swivels to pull to deep backward square
on the bounce to Chahal at short third, and Chahal can't collect it cleanly. Rahul went slashing at this length ball around sixth stump, but got it off the top half of the bat
uff, nearly taken by Ashwin! He stretched his right hand out, but the ball went past it, as Rahul walked down and chipped this length ball around off. Single to long-on
this dips on to a full length on middle, and Rahul sweeps again. The ball goes to deep backward square, with fine leg cleaning it to his left
tucks this length ball on middle and leg to deep midwicket
angles this in, and bowls on a fullish length on middle and leg. He went to clip but was hit high on his pad
fullish, and slower on off. A gentle nudge to long-on, as he leans forward to play at it. Rahul raises his fifty
again Rahul gets across, and sweeps this length ball. But this is outside off and turning away, even as Rahul plays it towards fine leg
change of pace, and a bouncer on sixth stump. He jumps in the crease to pull wide of long-on, and they pinch two

another low full toss, and this is six more! This travels over wide long-on. Boult goes for a slower ball, getting it to dip on to off, but Pooran is ready and waiting deep in the crease to hoick it across
drilled in the gap! This was a low full toss angling into off - perhaps Boult attempted a yorker - but Pooran drove at that from deep in the crease, between mid-off and extra cover
slashed over deep point! Short of a length from Boult, with the line being a bit wide outside off. Pooran rode the bounce and hacked hard for a flat six
on the bounce to deep point running forward! Boult went for quite a full length, and a bit wide of off, with Rahul nearly slicing it to the fielder, even as deep third was back on the fence too
bowls a short-of-a-length ball around sixth stump, and at a change of pace. Swatted to long-on
quite full, and angling into middle. Driven to extra cover for his third rapid single of the over
this is slower, and again on a fullish length on the stumps. Nudged behind square to keep ticking
gets across, and paddle sweeps for four! The ball was fullish on leg, and Rahul played swung his bat fairly well to place it between the keeper and short fine leg
slower, and dipping on a full length on sixth stump. Nudged to cover for another quick single
length ball on the stumps, and pushed wide of long-on with his front leg out of the way
length ball angling in and skidding through towards middle. Punched to extra cover for a hurried single

wow, this is great awareness! Now he ramps this short-of-a-length ball angling into him towards off, as he notices third man is up inside the circle. The bat seemed to have turned in his hands as he played that, but he still got four
chipped over mid-off! Not great timing, but this still trickles away to the rope. Rahul waits for this slower ball to come on a length slightly wide of off, and lofts it back for four
heaved over deep midwicket! On a length around sixth stump, and straightening away, as Rahul stood in his crease and had a full-fledged go at it
change of pace again, as he goes at a very full length just outside off. Dragged to long-on
he bowls a bouncer at a change of pace around seventh stump. Rahul gets across and swat-pulls to deep square
shorter side of a length on top of off, as Pooran rides the bounce to dab to deep third
on a length outside off, and he looks to chop but gets a bottom edge towards cover

ohh, Parag nearly takes a catch! He was placed at long-off, and moved to his left while keeping his eyes on this launch by Pooran, who sent it very high. Parag got his hands while tumbling to his right, but the ball dropped outside. Pooran went lofting at this fullish ball finishing wide of off, and just managed to get it for six
slower, and full on the stumps. Flicked to deep midwicket
on the shorter side of a length on middle, and quicker too. Punched to extra cover
fullish ball, and wide of off. He drives away from his body to deep backward point
short of a length on leg, and turning away. Pulled to deep midwicket
quite full length, and angling in towards off. Driven to long-on
another bouncer-length ball, but this angles in towards off. Pulled to deep backward square
yorker length on off, and squeezed back towards mid-off
Boult at deep midwicket takes it on two bounces, and turns around to throw it back. Rahul pulled this length ball just outside off, sending it racing away
bouncer on middle, and pulled to deep square after taking his eyes off
on a length just outside off, and punched to deep backward point
this is much fuller, and again a bit wide of off. Driven to point
on a length around sixth stump, and hinting to turn away. Pushed back to the bowler
on a fullish length, and wide of off. It angles away further, as Pooran looks to slash but is beaten. Wide called
full and quick at middle, and blocked down

nabbed at deep midwicket! Chahal strikes straight away. Jurel was actually placed a good few steps into the field of play, and had to take some steps back to gobble it in front of his stomach. Chahal tossed one up to invite Hooda, with the ball being fullish and outside off. Hooda skipped down and heaved, but it came off the inside half of the bat

fullish ball on middle and leg, and clipped to deep midwicket. Hooda set for an attempted two, and Rahul sent him back. But Hooda was still some distance away when the throw arrived, with the throw being a bit wide
full and dipping on middle, and chipped to a straightish long-on region. Parag is at long-on, and is again in action by running and tumbling to his left to save a few runs
this time the length is quite full, as the ball angles in towards off. Driven to extra cover
short of a length just outside off, and swat-pulled to midwicket
ahh, Parag again stops a few runs. He dives to his left - which is his wrong side - to cut this off, after Hooda hacked at this length ball in the corridor
clubbed over deep midwicket! A short-arm pull for six, as he spots this length delivery around sixth stump - it was a slower ball too - as Hooda pulled for another six
short in length from Avesh too, and on fifth stump. The ball skids on to Rahul, who pulls to long-on
on a length, and angled in. It arrives just outside off, and is pushed towards an imaginary cover-point
fuller length, and flatter on leg. Swung to long-on
this is bowled on a length on middle and leg, and nudged wide of long-on
this is shortish, and wide of off. Rahul makes room and slashes, but right to cover-point
on a length on middle, and pushed to long-on
short of a length on the stumps, and whipped to deep midwicket
swept over fine leg! Ashwin again went full on his pads, a Rahul got down on his back knee to deposit it for six with a full and free swing of his bat
starts with five wides. Bowls full and just outside leg, as Rahul looked to sweep but missed, and so did Samson
point has been sent back, as Rahul drives at this length ball angling back in towards off for a single to deep point
short of a length just outside off, and shaping back in towards off. Punched to cover-point
slower ball, but lofted over extra cover! He goes inside out by opening the face of the bat quite late at this fullish ball around fifth stump. Finally a boundary for Rahul

now Rahul is smacked on the helmet! And the physio is into action again. He is hit on his head, as he went pulling at this back-of-a-length ball pitching around sixth stump, but ending on middle. The ball went over his bat - a sign of some pretty good bounce on this pitch. Rahul is checked, and with everything fine, we are ready to resume
fuller side of a length, and angling in to finish just outside off. Pushed to mid-on for a hurried single
cover-point dives to his left, but can't get a hand. On the shorter side of a length and a bit wide outside off, as Hooda punched it between point and cover-point
good work by the man at point, who dives to his right to save a few runs. It was Parag there, as Rahul punched this short-of-a-length ball finishing around off after shaping away
fuller side of a length on middle and leg, and flicked to fine leg

this is some luck for Hooda! He went slashing late at this length ball just outside off, which was shaping away, but then seemed to have been beaten by the extra bounce. The ball took off from top edge, and went over the keeper
six behind the wicket! He spots this short-of-a-length ball arriving outside off, and sways away a bit to open the face of the bat and ramp it over deep third for six
short of a length on middle and leg, and nudged towards midwicket

spooned to mid-off! Buttler sees the ball dying on to him, and takes a low catch. Burger leaving Royals' mouths spicy already. He bowled on a length, while shaping it across the right-hander and arriving outside off. Badoni went lofting seeing the length, but couldn't time his shot, and found the man inside the circle
chips this full ball angling into him and coming on to middle stump. Single to deep backward square leg
he leans into this push off this length delivery in the channel, and plays to cover again
fuller side of a length, and pitches on sixth stump. It ends up closer to off, though, and is tapped to cover
angles this in, and bowls on a length and wide of off. Left alone

bowled him! This one keeps low after the previous one hammered his helmet. The ball hits the top of middle, and the stump is flattened. Boult went slightly on the shorter side of a length this time, while angling it into the left-hander. The ball pitched on or about off stump, and came back in while not entirely taking off from the pitch. Padikkal had shaped to swipe - perhaps seeing the length - and so it was too late by the time he tried to bend to keep that out
